D-grouse-drive-0087.parkWhat: pull off on Trout Creek FSR (gravel road)

evidence.t: Road: Trout Creek FSR, 4.8 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS).
3 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
3 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

flags.t: MU (Management Unit) 8-8, Region 8 Okanagan.
Private land 20 m SW: no shooting within 100 m (109 yd) of an occupied house or farm building (synopsis page 10, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 8 table, so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis).

plan: Drive: from Merritt, about 81 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 5A and 8 and 97C (Nicola Ave), Hwy 5A and 8 and 97C (Merritt-Princeton Hwy 5A), Hamilton Hill Rd, Hwy 97C and 5A.
Park: 49.7165, -120.1754, pull off on Trout Creek FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the Trout Creek FSR stretch, 4.8 km one way. About 96 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 8-8, Region 8. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-04, private land 2026-09-26, closures 2026-10-03.
